interactions.target_raw: Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(i) subunit alpha-1
interactions.note: The epitope of scFv16 on subunits of the heterotrimeric Gi protein was determined from the single-particle cryo-EM reconstruction of the human α(2B)adrenoceptor-Gi-scFv16 complex at a resolution of 4.1Å. The heterotrimeric Gi protein consists of bovine Gαi, rat Gß1 and human Gγ2. The α(2B)AR is bound to sedative sympatholytic dexmedetomidine. The single-chain variable fragment (scFv16)  binds to the interface of the G protein α- and β-subunits, was used to stabilize α2BAR–Gi complex.

interactions.note: The epitope of Fab16 on subunits of the heterotrimeric Gi protein was determined from the single-particle cryo-EM reconstruction of the rhodopsin-Gi complex-Fab16 complex at a resolution of 4.38 Å. The heterotrimeric Gi protein consists of human Gαi1 subunit and the Gβ1γ1 subunit isolated from bovine retinae. An active mutant of bovine rhodopsin N2C/M257Y/D282C was used. The complex was stabilized by Fab16.

interactions.note: The epitope of Fab_G50 on the Gi heterotrimer coupled to rhodopsin was determined from the cryo-EM structure of the rhodopsin–Gi–Fab complex determined at a nominal global resolution of 4.5 Å. A stable complex of activated rhodopsin was obtained bound to a dominant-negative mutant form of Gi, which was used to promote the nucleotide-free form of Gi. The Fab was used to further stabilize the active rhodopsin–Gi complex.

interactions.note: The epitope of nanobody Nb9156 on the G protein Gαi1 was determined from the single particle cryo-electron microscopy reconstruction of the Ric-8A:ΔN31Gαi1:Nb8109:Nb8117:Nb8119:Nb9156 complex to a resolution of 3.87 Å. Nanobody binding stabilized the complex of nucleotide-free Gα bound to phosphorylated Ric-8A.
